title: Keep Binance XRP phase-one availability unconfirmed; preserve escrow destination uncertainty; prioritize fresh-main workflow quarantine
context: Binance Recovery Update #4 lists XRP for progressive withdrawals during 06:00-09:00 UTC and reports 95% aggregate incident coverage, but the status page rendered no per-asset records.
XRP Insights reports the November 1 1B release at ledger 108038942 with zero re-escrow by that ledger; raw transaction destinations remain undecoded.
Main advanced to 760b61e; PR #1449 is the only current-main-based open PR and passed exact-head CI/gate, but remains draft and unmerged.
decisions: Classify Binance phase one as announced and XRP listed; do not classify XRP withdrawals as available until asset-specific status or successful transaction evidence is obtained.
Treat Binance's 95% aggregate recovery and 100% top-ten backing as company-reported, not independent proof or an XRP-specific acquisition figure.
Treat the escrow release as tracker-reported; do not infer sale, exchange deposit or market supply without raw Destination and follow-on transaction evidence.
Keep PR #1449 draft/unmerged; its 367 tests plus eight subtests and fail-closed gate validate the proposal only.
Do not admit the current event, derivatives or custody observations as directional features; no forecast is issued.
ingestion_contract: Capture the Binance network status page with displayed timestamp and timezone ambiguity preserved; require asset-specific XRP row or successful public withdrawal evidence.
Query XRPL account_objects/account_tx and validated transaction metadata for both escrow owners; record ledger index, transaction hash, Destination and affected nodes.
Keep company reserve claims, official PoR snapshots, market/OTC acquisitions and address-level liabilities as separate evidence classes.
Record source publication time, retrieval time, data cutoff, provider scope and missingness independently.
unresolved: Raw escrow Destination fields and subsequent XRP disposition.
Full repository CI, complete dependency scanning and security-alert review.

feature_admission.reason: Event status and source freshness are insufficient for a calibrated directional prediction.
